objective: Evaluate one already generated HFNet-SLAM trajectory and one already generated SuperVINS trajectory against official EuRoC MH_01_easy ground truth on one exact shared camera-timestamp support. This stage performs no model, ROS, publisher, trajectory generation, or inferential comparison.
sequence: official EuRoC MH_01_easy; not SuperVINS README-recommended V2_01

trajectory.format: timestamp_ns.000000 tx ty tz qx qy qz qw

stdout_log.role: Pins the observed pre-final-map failure/reset/not-enough-motion/lost history that the common tail excludes.

hfnet.semantic_boundary: The file is saved after Shutdown by reconstructing each frame from stored relative pose and the final optimized reference keyframe in the selected map; for inertial mode SaveTrajectoryEuRoC writes Twb. It is a final-map reconstructed world_T_body artifact, not an online-published state sequence.
hfnet.runability_warning_disclosure: The pinned HFNet stdout records repeated fail-to-track-local-map, not-enough-motion, active-map reset, and frames-set-to-lost events before the final saved trajectory prefix. The adopted runability evidence also records 31 warning lines, a cuDNN-version mismatch warning, an FP16 warning, seven local-map failures, and eight resets. SaveTrajectoryEuRoC then selects the final largest map and skips lost frames. The common window excludes this failed/reset prefix, and the prior stage did not clear accuracy or superiority claims. This evaluation is conditional on the sealed artifact only.

trajectory.format: timestamp_s_fixed6 tx ty tz qx qy qz qw
trajectory.pose_semantics: world_T_body online estimator state appended during the run

supervins.semantic_boundary: The file is an online-published/appended world_T_body estimator-state sequence, not a final-map reconstructed trajectory.

official_reference.frame_contract: Both estimated trajectories are world_T_body and both official sensor/IMU T_BS matrices are identity. Evaluate body position against GT body position; do not apply a camera extrinsic.

input_read_consistency_contract.reason: The HFNet trajectory, SuperVINS trajectory, and several reference files are not OS-read-only.
input_read_consistency_contract.preflight: Verify exact path, SHA-256, size, mode, and nlink for every frozen input/source without evaluating positions.
input_read_consistency_contract.run: Open every parsed mutable scientific/log artifact (both trajectories and run/log provenance, official camera/GT CSVs, and both T_BS YAMLs) with O_RDONLY|O_CLOEXEC|O_NOFOLLOW where supported, fstat the held descriptor, read exact bytes from that same descriptor into an immutable in-memory snapshot, verify SHA-256/size/mode/nlink against the lock, and parse only those snapshot bytes. Keep descriptors held until postflight; re-fstat and re-hash path bytes after outputs are complete. Other pinned source/runtime files receive complete pre/post path-identity audits. A path replacement, inode/device change, descriptor mutation, or postflight identity change is terminal FAIL.
input_read_consistency_contract.scientific_subprocesses: The evaluator shall spawn no subprocess and shall not start or stop any ROS/model/trajectory-generation process. Process scans are limited to relevant commands and never terminate unrelated processes.

support_contract.gt_join: Every common camera timestamp must join an exactly identical integer timestamp in official GT; no interpolation, extrapolation, or nearest-GT association.
support_contract.hfnet_binding: Validate each 19-digit-nanoseconds-plus-.000000 timestamp by string/Decimal arithmetic only; float-to-int conversion is forbidden. HFNet row i binds exactly to camera row 945+i. Common rows are HFNet camera rows 945..3659; the exact integer prefix must equal the camera timestamp.
support_contract.supervins_binding: Parse fixed-six seconds with Decimal only. SuperVINS row i binds by frozen formula camera row 63+2*i after text proximity <=1000 ns. Common rows correspond exactly to camera rows 945..3659; source nanoseconds are recovered from camera CSV, never float conversion or Decimal(text)*1e9 as restoration of source nanoseconds.

rpe_1s.pair_rule: Within the common odd-camera sequence, pair row i with row i+10, equivalent to camera-index delta 20.

coverage_disclosure.hfnet_missing_prefix_interpretation: This is the delay to the first pose retained in the final saved largest-map trajectory after earlier fail/reset/lost events, not evidence of one uninterrupted initialization delay.
coverage_disclosure.tail_interpretation: Post-index-3659 rows are outside the exact shared GT-covered window and are coverage boundaries, not algorithm-generation failures. Equal common accuracy support must not hide the different saved-output prefix coverage and histories.

alignment_contract.primary: For each system independently, fit one proper fixed-scale SE(3) transform from that system's 1358 common estimated body positions to the same 1358 GT body positions. Never share a transform and never fit on a system's full support.
alignment_contract.rank_gate: For each system and each alignment, centered source positions, centered GT target positions, and their cross-covariance must each have numerical rank >=2.
alignment_contract.proper_transform_gates: Every rotation is finite, det(R)>0 and within 1e-12 of +1, and max_abs(R^T R-I)<=1e-12. SE(3) scale is exactly 1. Sim(3) scale is finite and positive.
alignment_contract.fresh_se3_core_crosscheck: For each system, the fresh fixed-scale SE(3) aligned coordinates must agree with pinned trajectory_eval_core.align_se3_positions on the same 1358 pairs to <=1e-12 m maximum absolute coordinate difference.
alignment_contract.secondary_sim3: For each system independently, fit proper positive-scale Umeyama Sim(3) on the same 1358 points. Report scale and descriptive APE/RPE only as a diagnostic; it cannot replace the fixed-scale primary analysis or support ranking.

metric_contract.primary_ape: Euclidean translation error in metres after each system's independent common-support fixed-scale SE(3) alignment; n=1358 each.
metric_contract.primary_rpe: Euclidean error between aligned estimated and GT global-frame position deltas for the exact one-second pair rule; n=1348 each.
metric_contract.secondary: The same descriptive APE/RPE after each independent common-support proper Sim(3), plus positive finite scale.

comparison_and_claim_contract.allowed: Side-by-side descriptive rows for the two sealed artifacts on identical support.
comparison_and_claim_contract.delta_scope_note: The prohibition concerns arithmetic between HFNet and SuperVINS metrics. Within-system temporal/positional deltas used by the frozen RPE definition are required and are not cross-system comparison fields.
comparison_and_claim_contract.reason: There is one deterministic artifact per system, temporally correlated residuals, substantially different saved-output prefix coverage and histories, and different output semantics.
comparison_and_claim_contract.mandatory_disclosure: The common window and HFNet final-saved trajectory begin 44.1 s after SuperVINS' first output. HFNet's missing prefix contains repeated fail/reset/lost events and must not be described as one uninterrupted initialization delay. HFNet is a final-map reconstructed largest-map trajectory with lost frames skipped, whereas SuperVINS is an online-published estimator-state trajectory.
comparison_and_claim_contract.narrow_claim: Artifact-level conditional description on the exact common tail only; no winner, superiority, system-wide, initialization-equivalence, underwater, V2_01, or generalization claim.

analysis_bundle_contract.csv_order: camera row order 945..3659, and exact one-second pair order respectively
analysis_bundle_contract.json_serialization: UTF-8, sort_keys=true, indent=2, ensure_ascii=false, allow_nan=false, one trailing LF
analysis_bundle_contract.manifest: Manifest excludes itself and records each other required bundle file's exact relative path, SHA-256, size, mode, and nlink. Compute bundle_content_tree_sha256 over compact canonical JSON of the sorted [{path,sha256,size_bytes}] list. Manifest carries a canonical self_hash over its object with self_hash null. Terminal result pins the manifest.
analysis_bundle_contract.figures: Deterministic standard-library SVG. Spatial panels use one shared comparison domain and exact equal metres per pixel across XY/XZ panels. Time and error axes have exact lower bound zero. Horizontal and vertical gridline coordinates are mechanically audited. No uncertainty or significance annotations.

execution_contract.seal: Final freeze, lock, separate root authority, test receipt, start claim, every bundle file, and terminal result are mode 0444 with nlink=1.

preflight_contract.required_checks: All frozen pins; exact source row counts and timestamp-to-camera formulas; exact common indices/timestamps/GT joins/count/span; exact 1s pair count/deltas; coverage/init arithmetic; schemas; final seals; fresh root/start claim and authority absent; no relevant active generator/ROS/model process.

failure_closeout: After the fresh namespace or start claim exists, any exception or caught SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP produces one exclusive terminal FAIL result containing the frozen preflight pin snapshot, held-descriptor audit, available postflight pins, completed artifact identities, and error. SIGKILL cannot be guaranteed. No retry.
postcondition: A PASS supports only a side-by-side descriptive statement about these two pinned artifacts on the exact 135.7 s common GT-covered tail. It does not establish a winner, superiority, significance, equivalent initialization, online-state equivalence, V2_01 performance, underwater performance, or generalization.
